LOOK_AT.say: Two dollars and sixty cents, at ten per cent, from Mr. Sheng. The exact cost of my funeral.
repeat: He counted it into my hand twice: once for me, and once for the ledger.
I have borrowed money to pay for my own burial. I would like this kept out of the letters.
Nothing. It knows what it is for.
